profile_text.body:
EHang Holdings Ltd is a public company headquartered in Guangzhou and listed on NASDAQ under the ticker EH. On its own website the company describes itself as an autonomous aerial vehicle, or AAV, technology platform company and says its mission is to make safe, autonomous and eco-friendly air mobility accessible to everyone. It states that it provides AAV products and commercial solutions across urban air mobility, including passenger transportation and logistics, smart city management, and aerial media solutions, and describes itself as a forerunner of AAV technologies and commercial solutions in the global Urban Air Mobility industry.

The site lists product and service areas including passenger transportation, logistics, emergency rescue, aerial media, and infrastructure solutions. It also points visitors to news, video, partner, contact, careers, and investor relations sections.

The company's held record shows no tracked products, no lawsuits, and no MCP servers. Its profile lists a CIK of 0001759783 and an alias of EHANG HOLDINGS LTD-SPS ADR alongside its name.
